theme.designMd:
# Paytrace Design System
Brand: Paytrace — personal finance PWA that turns pasted payment SMS into categorized transactions.
Tone: calm, trustworthy, mobile-first.
Colors: primary sage/forest #2F6F4E on warm stone off-white surfaces. Avoid purple and harsh neon dark themes.
Type: Plus Jakarta Sans for headlines, Manrope for body/labels. Large readable money figures.
Components: bottom tab bar (Home, Paste, Activity, Insights), primary CTA = Paste SMS, category chips, transaction rows.
Touch targets 44px+. Minimal clutter. Brand name should feel prominent on Home.
